content.title: Phillies opening day 2026, how to get tickets, watch, weather, lineups
content.text: Updated March 26, 2026, 9:52 a.m. ETWe waited all winter for this day.Major League Baseball celebrates opening day this week and the Philadelphia Phillies will open their pursuit of a third straight National League East Division title and fifth straight NL playoff berth March 26.Here's what you need to know about opening day.When is Phillies opening day 2026?The Phillies open the season at 4:15 p.m. on March 26 against the Texas Rangers at Citizens Bank Park.This is the second time the Phillies have faced the Rangers on opening day. In 2023, they lost to the Rangers, 11-7, at Globe Life Park in Arlington, Texas.Who's is throwing out the ceremonial first pitch at Phillies opening day 2026?Lucas Bibro, a 10-year-old Nemours Children’s Hospital Delaware patient, alongside his cardiologist Dr. Mark Cartoski, will throw out the first pitch caught by Phillies shortstop Trea Turner.Also, to celebrate the All-Star Game being in Philadelphia, former Philadelphia Phillies All-Stars from the 1976 and 1996 All-Star games in Philadelphia – Larry Bowa, Greg “The Bull” Luzinski, Mike Schmidt and Ricky Bottalico – will throw a ceremonial first pitch to current Phillies All-Stars.Who is signing the national anthem at Phillies Opening Day 2026?Kane Kalas, son of the late Phillies Hall of Fame broadcaster Harry Kalas, will preform the national anthem at his father’s statue behind Section 141.Who are the starting pitchers for opening day 2026?The Phillies will start left-hander Cristopher Sanchez (13-5, 2.50 ERA) on opening day. Sanchez finished second in NL Cy Young Award voting and 15th in NL MVP voting last season. He just signed a six-year, $107 million contract extension.The Rangers will send right-hander Nathan Eovaldi (11-3, 1.73 ERA) to the mound for opening day.Potential starting lineups for opening day 2026Here's a projected Phillies lineup, according to Fangraphs:Trea Turner, SSKyle Schwarber, DHBryce Harper, 1BAlec Bohm, 3BBrandon Marsh, LFAdolis Garcia, RFBryson Stott, 2BJ.T. Realmuto, CJustin Crawford, CFHere's a projected Rangers lineup, according to Fangraphs.Brandon Nimmo, RFWyatt Langford, LFCorey Seager, SSJake Burger, 1BJosh Smith, 2BJosh Jung, 3BJoc Pederson, DHEvan Carter, CFDanny Jansen, CPhillies new centerfielder hopes to end trendRookie Justin Crawford is projected to open the season as the Phillies centerfielder. He will be the ninth different centerfielder to open the season in the last 10 years. If Crawford is starting in centerfield, it will be the first time Philadelphia had the same centerfielder to open the season since Odúbel Herrera started in three consecutive opening days from 2015 through 2017.Crawford would become just the fourth 22-year-old to start on opening day since 1955, according to MLB.com. The other four are Freddy Galvis (2012), Jimmy Rollins (2001) and Greg Luzinski (1973).Catcher J.T. Realmuto is the active leader in most consecutive opening day games started. If he's on the field on March 26, it will mark his eighth straight opening day start.Who's the favorite on opening day?According to BetMGM.com, the Phillies are a 1.5-run favorite over the Rangers. The over/under for runs scored is 8.5.Are the Phillies favored to win the World Series?The Phillies have the sixth-best odds to win the World Series at +1600, meaning if you bet $100, you would win $1,600 for a total payout of $1,700. The defending World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers have the best odds at +220.Are the Phillies favored to win the NL pennant?The Phillies have the third best odds to win the NL pennant at +800, according to BetMGM. The Dodgers have the best odds at +115.Are the Phillies favored to win the NL East?The Phillies are not the favorite to win the NL East. The Mets have the best odds at +135. The Phillies are second at +180.What's the Phillies record on opening day?The Phillies are 64-77-2 on opening day. The Phillies' longest opening day winning streak is six (1913-1918). The longest losing streak is eight (1985-1992).Is this the earliest opening day for the Phillies?Yes, March 26 will be the earliest day the Phillies have ever started the season. The previous earliest date was Mach 27 in 2025.What's the weather forecast for Phillies opening day 2026?It's going to be a perfect day for baseball. The forecast is calling for a partly sunny day with highs in the 70s. As the game goes on, the temperatures will drop into the mid- to upper 60s.When do the parking lots open on opening day 2026?The tailgating parking lots at Citizens Bank Park – lots A-H, M, N and O – open at 11 a.m. The other parking lots will open at 1 p.m.Parking lots at Citizens Bank Park are cashless. You'll need to use a debit/credit card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. The cost of parking a car is $30. An oversized vehicle taking up more than one space is $60.You can pre-pay for parking by clicking here.Handicap parking is available, but you must have proper license plates or a placard.When will the gates open at Citizens Bank Park for opening day 2026?The Third Base Gate and Left Field Gate will partially open at 2:15 p.m. The remaining gates will open at 2:45 p.m.What is Citizens Bank Park's bag policy?Only clutch purses and/or fanny packs (no larger than 5 inches by 7 inches), clear bags (no larger than 12 inches by 6 inches by 12 inches), medical bags and diaper bags will be permitted into Citizens Bank Park.How can I get Phillies single-game tickets?The Phillies are selling tickets to all 81 home games on the team's website.You can also get tickets by using the button below:Get Phillies tickets at Citizens Bank ParkWhat channel is Phillies opening day 2026 on?Channel: NBC 10, NBCSP+Stream: PHILLIES.TV, nbcsportsphiladelphia.com and the NBCSP app. NBCSP is also available on FuboTV, Hulu, Peacock and YouTube TV.Radio: 94WIP and WDEL 101.7 FM/1150 AMHow to stream Phillies games on PHILLIES.TVLast year, Major League Baseball and the NBC Regional Sports Networks announced a partnership to stream games direct-to-customers for the Phillies through the MLB App. The games are streamed on PHILLIES.TV.PHILLIES.TV will broadcast games and pregame and postgame shows during the regular season in the Phillies' home television market. The games will also be available on demand.To get PHILLIES.TV you can sign up here.Along with MLB.TV, certain Phillies games may be streamed on Netflix, Peacock and Apple TV+.Watch MLB games on PeacockPhillies schedule 2026The Phillies will have a number of good series at Citizens Bank Park this year, but the homestand after the All-Star break in July is epic. The Phillies host the New York Mets for three games, followed by the Los Angeles Dodgers for three games and finally the New York Yankees for three games. For the full 2026 schedule, check the Phillies website.Here's a look at some key dates and series in Philadelphia during the 2026 season.Opening Day: March 26 vs. Texas RangersNew York Mets: June 18-20 and July 17-19All-Star Game in Philadelphia: July 14New York Yankees: July 24-26Atlanta Braves: April 17-19 and Sept. 4-7Pittsburgh Pirates: June 29-July 2Los Angeles Dodgers: July 20-22Field of Dreams games vs. Minnesota: Aug. 13 in Dyersville, IowaSt. Louis Cardinals: Aug. 21-23Phillies projected roster for 2026 seasonCatchersJ.T.
